results.title: Dolphins Acquire Former First-Round Pick to Bolster Defense
results.description: As NFL training camps open across the league, another free agent has found a new home just in time. Clelin Ferrell, the former Las Vegas Raiders first-round selection, has signed with the Miami Dolphins, ending a stretch of free agency that had stretched through the entire offseason.
